We concluded the following four dimensions, where children appropriateness is the main metric for our educational application: 1. Question type: whether the generated questions belong to any of the three event types. 2. Validity: whether the generated questions are valid questions according to the original paragraph. 3. Readability: whether the generated questions are coherent and grammatically correct. 4. Children appropriateness: to what extent would you like to ask this question when you read the story to a five year's old child?
